title: Clone Graph
prompt: Given a reference of a node in a connected undirected graph, return a deep copy (clone) of the graph. Each node in the graph contains a val (int) and a list (List[Node]) of its neighbors.
hints: BFS or DFS with a map: old node -> new node. When visiting a node, create clone if not in map, add neighbors.
For each neighbor: if not cloned, clone and add to queue/stack. Add clone of neighbor to current node's neighbors.
Handle null input. Start from given node.
